card.name: Tiranossauro Negro
card.summary: Pode atacar diretamente se o oponente controlar somente monstros em Defesa e nenhuma outra carta.

textEvidence.text: If the only cards your opponent controls are Defense Position monsters, this card can attack directly. The condition inspects the entire opposing field, including Spell/Trap and Field Spell zones; if any nonqualifying opposing card is present, direct attack cannot be declared under this effect. When the field is empty, ordinary direct attacks are permitted. The card has no additional effect, cost, once-per-turn exception or duration; the condition is recalculated at every attack declaration and is disabled by monster-effect negation. It does not prevent attacks on monsters.
